hypothesis: Enqueue (try_send/send_all) and ack (note_ack_latency per record, note_acked per batch, fail_pendings) paths each lock Shared::topic_trackers (parking_lot Mutex<HashMap>) per record; caching the Arc<ProduceTopicTracker> on the FastRoute entry and carrying it on Pending removes ~2 locked lookups per record, saving ~3-5% cell CPU.
limits: The effect is REAL but under-bar, not noise: mixed paired mean -3.78% (n=20, CI [-5.3%,-2.3%], 19/20 rounds negative); bulk paired mean -4.89% (n=12, CI excludes zero, 11/12). Estimators disagree on size (mixed median-of-marginals -1.78%, median-of-deltas -2.7%, mean -3.78%) because machine drift (A_med 510 -> 519 -> 531 across batches) inflates marginal spread; interleaving + paired analysis control it. The bar miss is about the point estimate, not significance.

Same-source/different-binary broker luck measured at ~2-6% wall effect on ~70ms runs: bulk rec/s showed a paired-significant -2.69% deficit with per-variant brokers, which vanished (+4.14% median, CI includes zero) when both runtimes shared one nb-serve binary. Lesson: future A/Bs must share one broker binary (NB_SERVE) for wall-clock metrics; client CPU time is immune and confirmed the win (-5.90%, 5/5, CI excludes zero) in the control.

Reverted change (~80 changed lines in src/producer.rs, all reverted): FastRoute tuple gained Arc<ProduceTopicTracker>; Pending carried tracker; note_queued_via/note_acked_via/note_ack_latency_via/note_errors_via replaced per-record topic_tracker() lookups on enqueue, both ack paths, and fail_pendings. Batching behavior identical (bulk 6=6, mixed 48=48 produce_requests every round).

Kept test tracker_cache_mixed_topic_metrics_snapshot passes on parent code: it pins mixed-topic metrics behavior (global + per-topic rows + latency counts over try_send/send_all), not the reverted change.
